messages:
Maya: Hey team — Ledgerly billing for March shows a big spike on Invoice INV-8812. Looks like embedding usage jumped ~4x. Anyone else see this? Attached CSV sample.

billing-bot: Invoice INV-8812 generated: total $12,480. Usage: embeddings 4,200,000 units. Link: https://ledgerly.example/invoices/INV-8812

Tom: Maya, can you paste the CSV rows? need to match to contract items. Is this metered vs committed mismatch?

Maya: sure, snippet from the export:```
account,sku,region,units,unit_price,charge
redwood-prod,embeddings-eu,eu-west-1,4200000,0.002,8400
redwood-prod,embeddings-commit,eu-west-1,0,0.001,4000
promo_credit,legacy-mapping,eu-west-1,-4000, , -4000
```

Claire: Our encoder SDK rolled a change on Mar 10 that switched the batch strategy — might change how calls are metered (per-call vs per-token). Also we flipped to the new embeddings endpoint in prod on Mar 11.

Diego (Ledgerly Sales): Hi Maya — looking into INV-8812 now. Quick note: we did a billing SKU migration on Mar 12 that renamed `embeddings-eu` -> `embeddings-eu-metered`. If both legacy and new SKU records appear in a billing run it can look like doubled usage. Can you DM me the account id so I can pull raw logs?

Tom: Maya, procurement side: if this is due to Ledgerly migration we expect a pro-rated credit and a contract appendix mapping legacy SKU names to committed tiers. @Diego what is Ledgerly's remediation approach?

Diego (Ledgerly Sales): We can open a billing ticket and issue an invoice credit within 5 business days once we confirm the duplicate-counting. For the contract change, we can produce an appendix that maps old SKUs to new names and locks region pricing parity for committed customers; legal review + signoff ~2 weeks.

Maya: Sharing account id in DM (redwood-prod). Also the invoice shows eu-west unit_price 0.002 vs us-west 0.0016 — is there a regional surcharge? That would explain extra $1k.

Diego (Ledgerly Sales): Region surcharge was introduced for new regional pop pricing on Mar 1. However, for existing customers we'll honor parity for the current quarter; I'll flag to billing ops and we can apply a credit for parity for March.

Tom: Ok — next steps: 1) Ledgerly opens ticket and issues credit if migration caused duplication; 2) Ledgerly drafts SKU appendix and we review; 3) procurement to approve appendix before renewal if acceptable. If not, escalate to vendor management. @Claire please confirm whether our SDK/endpoint switch produced payload differences that could affect metering.

Claire: I'll diff the encoder payloads and the SDK request logs for Mar 9–13 and post findings here by EOD. If it looks like our change increased call count, we can revert the rollout while we sort billing.

Maya: Filing internal tracking ticket FIN-1023 to capture credits/contract actions. I'll update here once Diego shares the billing ticket id. :thumbsup:

Diego (Ledgerly Sales): Created ticket #LD-4551 for INV-8812. Billing ops will investigate duplicate SKU counting and regional parity. I'll follow up with a credit memo and an appendix draft. Sorry for the friction — we'll prioritize this.
